title: CasX Cleavage Assay
author: Liz O'Brien
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8wshxee

steps.title: Prepare labelled target strand stock
steps.instruction: Make 100 µL of labelled target strand DNA at a concentration of 100 nM.

steps.title: Assemble duplex DNA substrate
steps.instruction: Mix 50 µL of 100 nM labelled target strand with 50 µL of 120 nM unlabelled nontarget strand to obtain 100 µL of duplex substrate. For the reverse orientation, mix 50 µL of 120 nM labelled nontarget strand with 50 µL of 100 nM unlabelled target strand.

steps.title: Create 1:1.2 molar 32P labelled duplex
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1:1.2 molar ratio of 32P‑labelled target strand (TS) to unlabelled nontarget strand (NTS) as follows:

substeps.instruction: Dilute 4.48 µL of the 120 nM TS stock into 45.42 µL DEPC‑treated water.
Dilute 3.56 µL of the 120 nM NTS stock into 46.44 µL DEPC‑treated water.

steps.title: Anneal duplex and dilute to assay concentration
steps.instruction: Place the duplex mixture on a 95 °C heat block for 2–5 minutes, then allow it to slow‑cool for approximately 2 hours. After annealing, dilute the DNA stock to a final concentration of 120 nM using CasX reaction buffer.

steps.title: Prepare CasX reaction buffer
steps.instruction: Combine the following components: 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.5), 10 mM MgCl₂, 150 mM KCl, 1 % (v/v) glycerol, and 0.5 mM TCEP.

steps.title: Prepare CasX dilution buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 500 mM NaCl, 10 % (v/v) glycerol, 20 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 7.5), 1 mM MgCl₂, and 0.5 mM TCEP.

steps.title: Prepare quencher solution
steps.instruction: Combine 0.5 µg mL⁻¹ heparin with 25 mM EDTA.

steps.title: Dilute CasX protein to 4 µM
steps.instruction: Dilute CasX to a final concentration of 4 µM using the CasX dilution buffer prepared in step 6.

steps.title: Dilute sgRNA to 6 µM
steps.instruction: Dilute sgRNA to a final concentration of 6 µM using the CasX reaction buffer prepared in step 5.

steps.title: Form CasX‑sgRNA ribonucleoprotein (RNP)
steps.instruction: Mix CasX and sgRNA in an equimolar ratio: 2 µL sgRNA stock, 3 µL CasX stock, and 1 µL CasX reaction buffer. Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Dilute duplex DNA in reaction buffer
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of the annealed duplex DNA stock to 43 µL of CasX reaction buffer.

steps.title: Add RNP to DNA mixture
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of the 2 µM RNP stock to the DNA‑buffer mixture, bringing the total reaction volume to 50 µL.

steps.title: Incubate cleavage reaction and collect timepoints
steps.instruction: Incubate the 50 µL reaction at 37 °C. At each timepoint (0, 1, 5, 10, 30, 60, 120 minutes), remove 5 µL of reaction and immediately add it to a tube containing 5 µL quencher (equal volumes of reaction and quencher).

steps.title: Quench samples and incubate
steps.instruction: Allow the quenched samples to sit at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add loading dye and heat
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of formamide loading dye to each quenched sample and incubate at 95 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Run samples on 12 % PAGE gel
steps.instruction: Load 4 µL of each sample (≈200 cpm per well) onto a 12 % polyacrylamide gel. Pre‑warm the gel at 25 W for ~45 minutes, then run at 40–45 W for 45 minutes. Loading 50–100 cpm per well also works; gels may require overnight exposure for visualization.

steps.title: Prepare 2× formamide loading dye
steps.instruction: Prepare the dye by mixing 20 mL formamide, adding 2.2 mL of a 100 mM EDTA stock to reach a final EDTA concentration of 10 mM, and then adding a spatula tip‑ful each of powdered xylene cyanol and bromophenol blue.
